Verifies that {@link JacksonInject.Value#from(JacksonInject)} throws a {@link NullPointerException} when the annotation's {@code useInput()} returns {@code null}.

Internally, {@code from()} calls {@code src.useInput().asBoolean()}, so a {@code null} return from {@code useInput()} causes an NPE inside {@code JacksonInject$Value}.
Create a mock annotation whose useInput() and value() both return null, simulating a malformed or partially-configured JacksonInject annotation.
